_note: Officially announced parts the Taiwan sheet has not caught up with yet, added straight from the manufacturer's own release so a new set is not missing from the tier list for its first week or two. Appended onto the catalogue in loadCatalogue(). A relative `img` (no leading slash) points at a locally committed asset under public/, prefixed with BASE_URL at load time.
_when_the_sheet_catches_up: Delete the entry by hand. loadCatalogue() only steps aside on an exact id+cat match, and an entry written before the real data exists rarely guesses that exactly — UX-21 shipped here as UX-21-1 against the sheet's zero-padded UX-21-01, and every blade showed twice. Matching loosely is not the fix: folding zero-padding together would silently merge product ids that only look alike. Casing is a different matter — the sheet's `NR`/`Nr` and `OP`/`Op` really are one bit each, listed twice, and partOverrides.json drops the duplicate by name rather than by a matching rule. Copy the sheet's id format exactly (UX-21-01, not UX-21-1) and treat any entry here as temporary.
_over_blades: The CX Expand Blade over blades (cat 'overblade'), which the Taiwan sheet does not model at all — no category, no column, only an incidental note. Keyed by the single letter used in the CX product code (Break=B, Flow=F, Peak=P, Outer=O), the same convention the assist blades follow. No community or tournament source grades them yet, so `communityTier` is '-' and they show as Unrated; the box linkage in partOverrides.json is the useful part. Names sourced from the Beyblade wiki. Images are our own photos, background cut to transparent to sit on the dark cards like the rest, committed under public/overblades/.
